changelog:
- Initial release of the instagram-marketing skill for generating Instagram content from e-commerce product URLs.
- Automatically extracts product information using SkillBoss API Hub; supports Amazon, Shopify, Taobao, and others.
- Delivers ready-to-post Instagram content packages: image/video briefs, engaging captions, and optimized hashtags.
- Includes specialized content frameworks for various product categories and post types (feed, carousel, story, reel).
- Offers visual style guides, caption best practices, and campaign strategy templates for consistent, effective marketing.
summary: Generate Instagram marketing content from product URLs. Extract product information and create engaging Instagram posts with image suggestions, captions, and...
